import zlib

USERS = ["u%04d" % i for i in range(2000)]
CANARY_STEPS = [5, 25, 50, 100]
BLUEGREEN_STEPS = [0, 100]
# 每一步的健康快照：(新版本请求数, 新版本错误数)
CANSARY_HEALTH = [(80, 0), (300, 3), (600, 9), (0, 0)]
ABORT_HEALTH = [(80, 0), (300, 40), (0, 0), (0, 0)]
ERROR_PERMILLE_MAX = 30


def bucket(user):
    return zlib.crc32(user.encode("utf-8")) % 100


BUCKETS = {u: bucket(u) for u in USERS}


def routed(weight):
    return [u for u in USERS if BUCKETS[u] < weight]


def canary(steps, health):
    print("  step  weight  new_version_users  share_pct  err_permille  action")
    for i, w in enumerate(steps):
        n = len(routed(w))
        share = round(100.0 * n / len(USERS), 2)
        req, err = health[i]
        if req == 0:
            print("  %-5d %-7d %-18d %-10.2f %-13s %s" % (i, w, n, share, "-", "no_data"))
            continue
        pm = err * 1000 // req
        action = "abort_rollback" if pm > ERROR_PERMILLE_MAX else "continue"
        print("  %-5d %-7d %-18d %-10.2f %-13d %s" % (i, w, n, share, pm, action))
        if action == "abort_rollback":
            return True, i
    return False, None


RESULT = {}
for label, steps, health in (("canary", CANARY_STEPS, CANSARY_HEALTH),
                             ("canary_aborting", CANARY_STEPS, ABORT_HEALTH),
                             ("blue_green", BLUEGREEN_STEPS, CANSARY_HEALTH)):
    print("=== %s ===" % label)
    aborted, at = canary(steps, health)
    RESULT[label] = aborted
    print("  aborted=%s%s" % (aborted, "" if at is None else " at_step=%d" % at))

print("=== judgement ===")
n5 = len(routed(5))
n50 = len(routed(50))
n100 = len(routed(100))
print("users=%d" % len(USERS))
print("weight5_users=%d weight50_users=%d weight100_users=%d" % (n5, n50, n100))
print("canary_is_progressive=%s" % (0 < n5 < n50 < n100 == len(USERS)))
print("blue_green_is_atomic=%s" % (len(routed(0)) == 0 and len(routed(100)) == len(USERS)))
print("bucketing_is_stable=%s" % (routed(50) == routed(50)))
print("canary_aborts_on_error=%s" % (RESULT["canary_aborting"] is True))
print("healthy_canary_completes=%s" % (RESULT["canary"] is False))
